<span class="tag">Health economics</span> <span class="tag">Work in progress</span>

## Research direction

How does healthcare spending relate to malaria incidence and broader health outcomes across selected Sub-Saharan African countries?

## Proposed approach

Country-level panel analysis, descriptive statistics, diagnostic checks, and investigation of whether relationships differ across the outcome distribution or spending levels.

## Publication status

This page describes ongoing research interests. A final sample, paper, code, and empirical findings are not yet published here. No causal or numerical result is claimed on this page.
